notes.title: Update Version 3.3 - Background changes for Level 1 and Level 2
notes.notes:
[h1]Backgrounds Changed[/h1]

The 1st level looked very dull and has now been changed out to something that looks much better.
I've had feedback that level 2's background was making it difficult for some players to see enemies and pickups (yellowish gold rock background), this has now been changed to a black and white varient.  The detail remains but the colour has been removed.

[h3]Gauntlet Mode Bug Fix[/h3]

While making the sequel I noticed that Unity had created a sphere collider for one of my enemy objects.  This was causing issues (encountered when 2 of the same enemy type overlap) and the collider has been removed.  This bug if encountered would have stopped the player from progressing to the next wave of enemies.  Now fixed.

These updates have also been applied to the Astro Fighters DEMO.

[h1]Big Update Coming Soon[/h1]

The next big update for this version of Astro Fighters will be the ability to shoot in the downward direction.  This is a game changer and makes combat more fluid.  It exists in the sequel code but i'll need to unpick this and copy it to this game.  Will also need to heavily test before making the change live.

notes.title: Version 2.9 - Explosion Size Selection Added
notes.notes:
[h1]Explosion Size Choices[/h1]

I've added a drop down on the settings menu so the player can decide the size of the explosions for themselves.  Selecting "Large" will render explosions at the size I originally decided on when developing the game.  Selecting "Small" will render the explosions at half the size and "Medium" will be half way between Small and Large.

The default option will be set to "Small" which complies with the previous update.

I just thought it would be nice to have the option to alter this within the menu, some people might like the bigger bangs ;-)

notes.title: Version 2.8 - Explosions Fixed
notes.notes:
[h1]Explosion Size and Spawn Position Fixes[/h1]

I have received feed back from youtube "IoriBranford" that the explosions are too big and interupt the visibility of enemy bullets and the player ship.

As a result of this feed back i've reduced the explosion sizes by half and also spawned them 1 x unit below the destroyed enemies.  This means that everything else on screen should be rendered above the explosions.

Big should out to IoriBranford.  Go visit them channel on youtube, link below.
https://www.youtube.com/@IoriBranford

notes.title: Version 2.2 - Changes to in game Rank UI, Bonus scores and new Backgrounds added
notes.notes:
[h1]In Game Player Rank UI Changes[/h1]

The player will now see who has the next score to beat on the leaderboard, their score and also how many points away from reaching that next rank score they are during play.  This change should hopefully incentivise players to push on for higher scores (beating their friends and other players) and is available on both the campaign and gauntlet mode.  This also works for Player 2 in game.

[h1]Bonus Score Refinement[/h1]

Playing on a higher difficulty setting will now yield higher bonus scores for max leveling your power and remaining lives.  This will ensure elite players are rewarded with higher scores on the leaderboard.

[h1]New Backgrounds Added[/h1]

Many new backgrounds have been added to the Gauntlet Mode.  Because the mode is procedural and therefore endless, I thought it would be nice to add further backgrounds to this game mode. Over 1GB of textures have now been added to the game as a result but I hope players appreciate my attempt to make the mode feel fresh if they've already completed the regular campaign mode.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

Have fixed a long standing bug where some bullets would not be fired at the player correctly by some enemies / bosses.  As a result level 4 and level 5 may be slightly more difficult but the gameplay is now as intended when I developed those levels.

[h3]Closing Comments[/h3]

I hope you the players appreciate the time and effort that goes into making a video game.  I've tried to create a game that's enjoyable, accessible and also competitive and i'm certainly not done tweaking the game.  I plan to reward players on higher difficulty modes with access to more bonus points etc so that these elite players emerge higher on the global leaderboards (as they should do).

If you've enjoyed the game a review and recommendation really helps us solo indie developers and I would very much appreciate the support.  It's a few clicks and a few kind words, if you can spare them it really does help me to keep motivated.

Any feedback is welcome.

Thanks my fellow Astro Fighters
Paul

notes.title: Version 2.0 - New Game Mode Added
notes.notes:
[h1]Gauntlet Mode Added[/h1]

This new game mode is for expert players only.
You will start with 3 lives only and will not earn any new lives.

Enemy formations will be randomised with the game mode getting more difficult the further you progress.  Boss battles will be presented and the bosses will have less health than in the main game but be warned, they will be supported now by other enemy types..

A new enemy type has been added also exclusively for this game mode.

[h3]How to unlock[/h3]
Beat Level 3 of the main game campaign.
If you have already beaten level 3 of the main game you will automatically unlock Gauntlet Mode

Please not that this is now a major update and as such the retail version of the game is now branching away from the demo version of the game.  The demo will not include this game mode but will still be supported with any future updates / improvements applied to the retail version that are relavent to the demo experience.

Thank you all for playing the game Astro Fighters and if you really want to support me and the game, please leave a nice review.  Reviews help the game reach a larger audience and in turn will hopefully lead to more competition on the high scores tables.

Happy Easter
Paul

notes.title: Player UI and High Score Changes
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.6 Changes[/h1]

[h3]Player UI Notifications[/h3]

When the player gets a notification for ranking up, extra lives or points etc the notification appears just underneath the player ship.  If the player is right near the bottom of the screen the notification will display above (in front of) the player ship.  Most bullet dodging happens towards the bottom of the screen so now the player will not miss any notifications.

[h3]Extended the High Scores Display[/h3]

The high scores can now show up to the top 100 scores across 10 score boards.  If the board has no score to show then the first board will display again and the loop will continue indefinitely until the player goes back to the main menu.  Score boards will display for 10 seconds each.

These changes have also been applied to the DEMO version of the game.

[h1]Coming Soon[/h1]

[h3]Gauntlet Mode[/h3]

Gauntlet mode will be an unlockable procedurally generated mode that offers advanced players a chance to compete for even higher scores at incrementing difficulties. Players will have a maximum of only 3 lives in the Gauntlet mode (which will have it's own leader board) and new enemy types not seen in the main campaign may make an appearance!

The game mode will also be available for 1 or 2 players just like the main campaign modes.

No 2 plays of Gauntlet Mode should be the same and it will offer endless replayability to fans of the game. I'm looking forward to bringing this new game mode to those that are worthy very soon!

notes.title: Player UI and High Score Changes
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.5 Changes[/h1]

[h3]Player UI[/h3]

The in game player UI will now intelligently move when the player / players are close to the UI on screen.  The UI has previously been static and hinders bullet dodging in the bottom corners of the play field.  Now the UI will quickly move to a lower position that only shows your score / rank and available special buttons (based on your graze bar). 

[h3]High Score Leader Boards[/h3]

Previously the High Scores would only show the Top 10 high scores.  This has now been changed to show up to the Top 40 scores.  Each of the Top 10, 20, 30 and 40 score boards will show for 10 seconds before changing.

These changes have also been applied to the DEMO version of the game.

[h1]Coming Soon[/h1]

notes.title: Version 1.4 Released
notes.notes:
[h1]Difficulty Mode Explanations[/h1]
I've now added a difficulty mode explanation to the title screen so players can now see what each difficulty mode represents in terms of challenge.

[h1]Difficulty Tweaks[/h1]
Altered the amount of maximum lives for each difficulty mode and added an amount of grade points to be awarded on death (amount dependant on difficulty mode).  This change was only previously made to Easy and Normal difficulty modes but is now applied to Hard and Extreme modes.

notes.title: Version 1.3 Released (Bullet Graze Hit Box Changes)
notes.notes:
[h1]Graze Hit Box Changes[/h1]

An additional bullet graze hit box zone has been added for each player ship.

The graze hit boxes have also been enlarged making it easier to graze bullets and build the graze points meter.

This change has been implemented as a direct result of player feedback and I thank you all for the kind words, support and advise.

I hope you continue to enjoy the game and look forward to more updates in the near future.

Oh and the DEMO version has also been updated in line with this 1.3 version.

Thank you!
Paul
